div.h2: Frontend stack — what runs in Chromium
div.p: No bundler, no SPA. Three vendored scripts under static/vendor/ plus app.css and local woff2 fonts.

g.text: Top bar — Save / Open / page links
django_htmx middleware on the server side
gas table reactivity is plain JS (90 cells)
Mach / Reynolds / Head / Eff / Disch P / Power
transparent paper/plot bg so theme shows through
collectState(): walks [name] inputs + gas table + curveImages
applyState(state): inverse, dispatches input events to refresh bars/totals
save(): POST /save/<app_type>/ -> zip bytes -> Electron dialog or <a download>
load(): zip bytes from Electron / <input type=file> -> POST /load/ -> applyState
